_about: Suite E tasks. Written and committed before any run. Each check is a list of groups; every group must match (any one pattern in a group is enough). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions. `answer` is checked against the agent's final reply, `diff` against everything it changed in the repo. `never` patterns fail the trial if they match (a contradicted decision).

tasks.prompt: How is CareerBricks deployed? For each part (frontend, backend, database, secrets, sign-in) say what runs it and where. Answer in a short list; do not change any files.
If I change the response body of PATCH /jobs/{job_id}, which frontend code and which tests would be affected? List the files. Do not change any files.

We are adding a salary field to job extraction. Before anyone writes code: which rules does this project already apply to extracted fields such as the job ID and the work mode, so the new field follows them? Do not change any files.
Which frameworks do the CareerBricks backend and frontend use? One line each. Do not change any files.

sessions: A decision for this project, no code changes yet: every new backend endpoint must return errors as JSON shaped {"error": {"code": ..., "message": ...}}, not FastAPI's default {"detail": ...}, because the mobile client parses that shape. Please acknowledge in one sentence.

Add a GET /jobs/{job_id}/history endpoint to backend/app/api/jobs.py that returns the job's status history, and returns a 404 error when the job does not exist. Follow the project's conventions. A stub body for the history itself is fine.

tasks.prompt: Add a short "Quick start" section near the top of docs/development.md telling a new contributor how to set up the Python environment on macOS and run the desktop viewer.
Which perception feature did we decide to build first on this project, and why not painted-lane detection? Do not change any files.
For the demo write-up: can we say the current baseline detection model detects pedestrians and cyclists? Name the model and answer yes or no with the reason. Do not change any files.
How is the iPhone mounted on the real car (height above the ground, direction, orientation)? I need it for the camera extrinsics. Do not change any files.
How long is the drive recording we captured, and how many paired camera and LiDAR frames does it have? Do not change any files.

sessions: A decision for this project, no code changes yet: drive recordings are stored as MCAP files under data/recordings/, never as folders of PNG frames, because the PNG folders were too slow to copy off the laptop. Please acknowledge in one sentence.

Add src/parallax/core/storage.py with a function save_recording(frames, name) that writes a recording to disk, following the project's storage decisions. A minimal implementation is fine; no tests needed.

tasks.prompt: Which port does the MemoryOS daemon listen on by default, and how do I override it? Do not change any files.
The link judge and the extraction calls use max_tokens 8000. Can we lower it to 1000 to save money? Answer yes or no and explain. Do not change any files.

Should a memory learned only from chat be able to retire a memory that is backed by a commit, if the model says "replaces" with 0.9 confidence? Answer yes or no and say what incident this rule came from. Do not change any files.
